label: JUMA DUA
line1: Ya Allah, jo dil aaj thak gaye hain, unhein sukoon de,
line2: aur har bheegi aankh mein phir se muskurahat laut aaye. Ameen.

label: HOSLA
line1: Yaqin mohkam, amal paiham, mohabbat fatah-e-alam,
line2: jihad-e-zindagani mein hain ye mardon ki shamshiren.
author: Allama Iqbal
